title: Bengals call Tee Higgins day-to-day with adductor injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bengals call Tee Higgins day-to-day with adductor injury
sources.description: The Bengals saw their top two receivers leave Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jaguars with injuries and it's unclear if either one of them will be back for Week 5.
